technicalNotes:
When found on VW Passat 3B (1998-2005): Often seen when mismatched salvage or rebuilt ABS Elektroniği have been installed. Before proceeding with any other troubleshooting, Kontrol edin: the ABS Elektroniği part number seen at address 03 on a VCDS Auto-Scan and verify fitment using the ETKA or PL24 parts catalogs or contact a dealer parts department. Also verify the part number physically stamped on the ABS hydraulic block either matches that of ABS Elektroniği module seen at address 03 or is a valid "repair kit" for that hydraulic block.
Examples seen in the field: 01 02 03 04 05
